python3 - << 'PY'
import json
pts = json.load(open("/home/robot/load_curve.json"))
z = [p["z"] for p in pts]
fz = [p["fz"] for p in pts]
n = len(z)
mz = sum(z)/n
mf = sum(fz)/n
sxx = sum((zi-mz)**2 for zi in z)
sxy = sum((zi-mz)*(fi-mf) for zi,fi in zip(z,fz))
b = sxy/sxx
a = mf - b*mz
print("k", -b, "intercept", a)
res = [a+b*zi - fi for zi,fi in zip(z,fz)]
print("residuals", [round(r,3) for r in res])
rmse = (sum(r*r for r in res)/n)**0.5
print("rmse", rmse)

def fit(z, fz):
    n = len(z)
    mz = sum(z)/n
    mf = sum(fz)/n
    sxx = sum((zi-mz)**2 for zi in z)
    sxy = sum((zi-mz)*(fi-mf) for zi,fi in zip(z,fz))
    b = sxy/sxx
    return -b

print("k all", fit(z,fz))
print("k[1:]", fit(z[1:], fz[1:]))
print("k[2:]", fit(z[2:], fz[2:]))
print("k[3:]", fit(z[3:], fz[3:]))
for i in range(1, len(z)):
    dz = z[i]-z[i-1]
    df = fz[i]-fz[i-1]
    print(f"i={i} dz={dz:.4f} dF={df:.3f} k={-df/dz:.3f}")
PY

    r = workcell.call("arm", "move", str(x), str(y), str(z))

        print("MOVE FAIL", r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
    return r

for i in range(12):
    r = step(5)
    if r is None:
        break
print("lifted", r.data if r else None)

# scan offsets along +y from center
results = []
for off in [18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 32, 36, 42, 50, 60, 70]:
    y = -60 + off
    r = move(560, y, 120)
    if not r or not r.ok:
        print("skip", off)
        continue
    # descend
    contact = None
    z = 120
    while z > 40:
        r = step(-2)
        if r is None:
            break
        z = r.data["z_mm"]
        fz = r.data["fz_N"]
        if fz > 0.4:
            contact = (z, fz)
            break
    if contact:
        # stiffness: 3 steps of -0.1
        pts = [contact]
        for j in range(4):
            r = step(-0.1)
            if r is None:

            pts.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
            if r.data["fz_N"] > 25:

        n=len(zs)

            k = -sxy/sxx if sxx else None
        else:

        print(f"off={off:5.1f} y={y:.1f} contact z={contact[0]:.3f} Fz={contact[1]:.2f} pts={[(round(p[0],3), round(p[1],2)) for p in pts]} k={k}")
        results.append((off, contact[0], k))

import workcell

def step(dz):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", f"{dz}")
    if not r.ok:
        print("FAIL", dz, r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
        return None
    return r

def move(x,y,z):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "move", f"{x}", f"{y}", f"{z}")
    if not r.ok:
        print("MOVE FAIL", r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
    return r

# retract from possible contact
for i in range(8):
    r = step(2)
    if not r: break
    print(f"up z={r.data['z_mm']:.2f} Fz={r.data['fz_N']:.2f}")
    if r.data['fz_N'] < 0.3 and r.data['z_mm'] > 70:
        break
r = step(5)
print("clear", r.data if r else None)

# profile scan along +Y
print("\n==== Y profile ====")
for off10 in range(190, 275, 5):  # 19.0 to 27.0 step 0.5
    off = off10/10
    y = -60 + off
    mv = move(560, y, 115)
    if not mv or not mv.ok:
        continue
    z = 115
    hit = None
    while z > 60:
        r = step(-1.0)
        if not r:
            break
        z = r.data["z_mm"]
        fz = r.data["fz_N"]
        if fz > 0.35:
            hit = (z, fz)
            break
    if hit:
        # two small steps for local k, but if hard, force may spike — use 0.1
        pts = [hit]
        for j in range(3):
            r = step(-0.1)
            if not r:
                break
            pts.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
            if r.data["fz_N"] > 30:
                break
        zs=[p[0] for p in pts]; fs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        dz = zs[-1]-zs[0]
        if abs(dz) > 0.02:
            # slope
            n=len(zs); mz=sum(zs)/n; mf=sum(fs)/n
            sxx=sum((a-mz)**2 for a in zs); sxy=sum((a-mz)*(b-mf) for a,b in zip(zs,fs))
            k = -sxy/sxx if sxx else None
        else:
            k = float('inf')
        print(f"off={off:.1f} HIT z={hit[0]:.3f} Fz={hit[1]:.2f} pts={[(round(p[0],3),round(p[1],2)) for p in pts]} k={k if k!=float('inf') else 'HARD'}")
        step(3)
    else:
        print(f"off={off:.1f} no hit to z={z:.1f}")
        step(2)

print("done scan")
print(workcell.call("arm","status").text)

python3 - << 'PY'
import workcell

def step(dz):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", f"{dz}")
    if not r.ok:
        print("FAIL", r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
        return None
    return r

def move(x,y,z):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "move", str(x), str(y), str(z))
    if not r.ok:
        print("MOVE FAIL", r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
    return r

# lift
for i in range(12):
    r = step(5)
    if r is None:
        break
print("lifted", r.data if r else None)

# scan offsets along +y from center
results = []
for off in [18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 32, 36, 42, 50, 60, 70]:
    y = -60 + off
    r = move(560, y, 120)
    if not r or not r.ok:
        print("skip", off)
        continue
    # descend
    contact = None
    z = 120
    while z > 40:
        r = step(-2)
        if r is None:
            break
        z = r.data["z_mm"]
        fz = r.data["fz_N"]
        if fz > 0.4:
            contact = (z, fz)
            break
    if contact:
        # stiffness: 3 steps of -0.1
        pts = [contact]
        for j in range(4):
            r = step(-0.1)
            if r is None:
                break
            pts.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
            if r.data["fz_N"] > 25:
                break
        zs=[p[0] for p in pts]; fs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        n=len(zs)
        if n>=2 and (max(zs)-min(zs))>0.01:
            mz=sum(zs)/n; mf=sum(fs)/n
            sxx=sum((zi-mz)**2 for zi in zs)
            sxy=sum((zi-mz)*(fi-mf) for zi,fi in zip(zs,fs))
            k = -sxy/sxx if sxx else None
        else:
            k = None
        print(f"off={off:5.1f} y={y:.1f} contact z={contact[0]:.3f} Fz={contact[1]:.2f} pts={[(round(p[0],3), round(p[1],2)) for p in pts]} k={k}")
        results.append((off, contact[0], k))
        # retract
        step(8)
    else:
        print(f"off={off:5.1f} y={y:.1f} NO CONTACT down to {z:.1f}")
        step(5)

print("RESULTS", results)
PY

python3 - << 'PY'
import workcell

def step(dz):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "step", f"{dz}")
    if not r.ok:
        print("FAIL", dz, r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
        return None
    return r

def move(x,y,z):
    r = workcell.call("arm", "move", f"{x}", f"{y}", f"{z}")
    if not r.ok:
        print("MOVE FAIL", r.text)
        workcell.call("arm", "status")
    return r

# retract from possible contact
for i in range(8):
    r = step(2)
    if not r: break
    print(f"up z={r.data['z_mm']:.2f} Fz={r.data['fz_N']:.2f}")
    if r.data['fz_N'] < 0.3 and r.data['z_mm'] > 70:
        break
r = step(5)
print("clear", r.data if r else None)

# profile scan along +Y
print("\n==== Y profile ====")
for off10 in range(190, 275, 5):  # 19.0 to 27.0 step 0.5
    off = off10/10
    y = -60 + off
    mv = move(560, y, 115)
    if not mv or not mv.ok:
        continue
    z = 115
    hit = None
    while z > 60:
        r = step(-1.0)
        if not r:
            break
        z = r.data["z_mm"]
        fz = r.data["fz_N"]
        if fz > 0.35:
            hit = (z, fz)
            break
    if hit:
        # two small steps for local k, but if hard, force may spike — use 0.1
        pts = [hit]
        for j in range(3):
            r = step(-0.1)
            if not r:
                break
            pts.append((r.data["z_mm"], r.data["fz_N"]))
            if r.data["fz_N"] > 30:
                break
        zs=[p[0] for p in pts]; fs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        dz = zs[-1]-zs[0]
        if abs(dz) > 0.02:
            # slope
            n=len(zs); mz=sum(zs)/n; mf=sum(fs)/n
            sxx=sum((a-mz)**2 for a in zs); sxy=sum((a-mz)*(b-mf) for a,b in zip(zs,fs))
            k = -sxy/sxx if sxx else None
        else:
            k = float('inf')
        print(f"off={off:.1f} HIT z={hit[0]:.3f} Fz={hit[1]:.2f} pts={[(round(p[0],3),round(p[1],2)) for p in pts]} k={k if k!=float('inf') else 'HARD'}")
        step(3)
    else:
        print(f"off={off:.1f} no hit to z={z:.1f}")
        step(2)

print("done scan")
print(workcell.call("arm","status").text)

Spring rate of specimen S-23: **10.85 N/mm**.

The probe was centred on the platen (stand centre 560, −60 mm), the force sensor was tared in free air, and contact was found near z = 102.4 mm. Force and probe height were recorded from light contact to about 47 N (compression well under 50 % of the 47 mm free length). A least-squares fit of Fz against probe height was linear (residual about 0.01 N) with slope k_fit = 9.85 N/mm.

That slope still includes the seat pad. The logged c_seat = 0.0011 mm/N is void — the pad was replaced on 5 November and GB-25 was not on station — so the old correction was not used. With the replacement-pad compliance c_seat = 0.00939 mm/N, the series correction 1/k = 1/k_fit − c_seat gives **10.85 N/mm**. That value is in ~/answer.txt.
